No date given. ReserveOhio nonetheless shows 2027-04-20 free in A (62 of 112) and D (51 of 68), and ODNR's map is revised 02/26 with new numbering. Not a status: B, C and the boat camp operate.

WATERFRONT holds (lakefront): 'Premium (waterfront)' is ODNR's own label. Plotted: ReserveOhio's D-area points are stretched out into the lake (hand-placed), so judged from the OSIP pads and ODNR's map instead. D's eastern peninsula pads stand about 30-60 m from Indian Lake's open riprap shore across mown lawn; 446-452, 430-433 and 405-408 are the shore ends on ODNR's map. The channels are open arms of the lake at pool level (ODNR's map labels them 'Channel', and they connect), and sites along them (e.g. 89-92, 222-225) are nightly, RV-usable and premium or full hookup with pads of 29-48 ft.
